summary: asus rog strix scar 17 g733qm - system state baseline
suggested_solution: Power Management: Explore advanced power settings in Windows (processor power management, link state power management).
Hardware Diagnostics: Run extended Memtest86 (RAM) and SSD diagnostics to rule out hardware issues.
BIOS Settings: Double-check for any settings related to CPU C-State and iGPU usage that might influence the behavior of the system.
